homeTitle: Huzzah | Sebastian Harder: Production Design & Props, Toronto
homeDescription: Sebastian Harder's Huzzah studio in Toronto: production design, pre-vis and props for film, TV and commercials. Canadian Screen Award winner.
tagline: Production design, pre-vis and props for film, television and commercials.
bio: Huzzah is a Canadian digital film services company in Toronto that has won a Canadian Screen Award. Sebastian Harder leads the company, bringing over ten years of film and television experience. His work has appeared in feature films, advertising, and TV.
vfxBio: Huzzah is a Canadian Screen Award winning digital film services company based in Toronto, Canada. Headed by Sebastian Harder, Huzzah brings more than a decade of experience working in film and television. His work has been featured in feature films, advertising and on TV.
vfxIntro: Huzzah creates award-winning VFX for film, television and the web, for projects at every budget level, including Kids in the Hall and Longing. Winner of a Canadian Screen Award for VFX.
kicksIntro: Not everything I do is for money.
